## location
**23 run(s)** — rule `lewis22-PRJEB47693-location` — 10.1111/ppa.13532  
*Table S1 (PPA-71-890-s005.xlsx), header at row 2*

> Isolate table, 96 accession rows: Isolate ID, Original isolate ID, Date collected, Country, Location, Latitude and longitude, Host, Host variety, Data type, Data source, Bioproject, Accession, Reference. 34 rows carry Bioproject PRJEB47693, matching the deposit exactly. Location is an Irish county (Cork, Kilkenny, Waterford, Carlow, Laois), a French commune (Louville la Chenard) or a UK town (Kelso, Brandon) for 32 of them, and the literal '-' for IT-05 and FR-01. 'Latitude and longitude' is a column but is '-' on every row. Isolate-level columns are filled only on the first row of each isolate's block, so they must be forward-filled. Keyed by Accession, an ENA secondary sample accession (ERS); lewis22.py resolves ERS to run through the cached ENA portal table. Date collected is day-precision where the archive holds only a year.
